title: Proofreading checklist: CAPS, full stops, spelling, sense
subject: English
source: Seeded from english/y2 lesson 101 (Proofreading checklist: CAPS, full stops, spelling, sense (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 101: Proofreading: finding and fixing our own mistakes. Tick each one when it is in your writing. Ask a partner to check too.

rows: Capital letters for sentences and names
Full stops, question marks and exclamation marks
Commas in lists and after fronted adverbials
Spellings checked (circle any you are not sure of)
Every sentence makes sense when read aloud
Paragraphs start on a new line
